about_the_game:
After their ultimate battle with Fujin and Raijin, Hiro and his companions enjoyed peaceful days at his grandfather's house.
One day in Japan, Sanbi sensed a distant summons. Troubled by the call, she informed Hiro. After thorough research and careful energy tracing, they discovered its source—her main body, the legendary nine-tailed fox, residing somewhere in China.
Determined to uncover the truth, Hiro, Sanbi and Yoshiko set off on a journey to The Land of Dragons, ready to face whatever awaited them and unravel the mystery behind Sanbi’s summons.



  • Players will now navigate their adventure on a hex-based map featuring diverse floor designs.


  • Explore various hex-node types, including battles, treasure chests, and scenario events, to strengthen your units.
  • Upgrade Hiro’s abilities after each run to take on even more formidable foes!
  • Collects god's boon and relics to improve your team power.




  • Experience strong Japanese yokai-culture inspired environment concept.
  • Earn by destroying the enemy and spending your resources to upgrade each unit type.
  • Strategically position your units onto a chess-based battlefield to defend your territories.
  • Planning ahead to defeat elite Yokai and its minions
  • Vary Japanese folklore yokai with different attack patterns—long-range, melee, tanky unit..


  • Encounter a variety of Japanese and Chinese folklore yokai, each with unique attack patterns.
  • Face off against powerful elite enemies and epic bosses waiting to be conquered.




  • Strategically position your units on a chess-based battlefield to defend your territory.
  • Harness Powerstones to evolve your units into their ultimate forms and unleash powerful skill attacks.

content_descriptors.notes: Mature imagery. Users can unlock characters in the game where they are wearing revealing costumes and/or in suggestive poses and voices.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: with 512 MB VRAM or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: After defeating Fujin and Raijin, Hiro and his allies found peace at his grandfather’s house. One day, Sanbi sensed a distant summon. After tracing the energy, they discovered it came from her true form—the nine-tailed fox. Determined to help, Hiro and his friends set off on a new journey.
